scope.summary: Integrate BodyKit work with the job scheduler per Section 13.27: generation, corrective/skin bakes, and exports run as typed Handshake JOBS honoring leases, backpressure, and cancellation, with event-before-row discipline on cancellation and TAILOR_BODY_* lifecycle events on the Flight Recorder for every transition.
acceptance_criteria: Body generation, corrective re-bakes, soft-tissue settles, skin bakes, and profile exports each enqueue as typed job kinds under the kernel scheduler with leases and backpressure (no unbounded queue growth under a burst test).

Cancellation mid-bake/mid-export leaves no partial authority writes: event-before-row ordering holds, intermediate artifacts are cleaned or marked orphaned-typed, and the job result is CANCELLED with attribution.
TAILOR_BODY_* lifecycle events (queued/started/progress/completed/failed/cancelled) emit to the Flight Recorder for every transition, consistent with the 13.14 event family registration from MT-483.
Concurrent job lanes across bodies run in parallel without lease contention on unrelated rows (load test with mixed job kinds).
Long-running jobs surface progress in RUNTIME status/TraceProjection so models observe without polling.
scope.risk_if_missed: Heavy BodyKit work (bakes, exports) runs outside the scheduler — unbounded, uncancellable, invisible to the Flight Recorder — starving the kernel under swarm load and leaving corrupt half-written state on every interruption.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
